name: Surfel Rendering with Depth Shading and Soft Shadows
definition: Renders a 3D point cloud as 2D surfels using per-point sprites, applies depth-based color shading, and composites a soft projected floor shadow to provide visual grounding without altering point locations or semantic colors.
summary: Surfel Rendering with Depth Shading and Soft Shadows renders 3D point clouds as 2D surfels using perspective-scaled soft shadows and continuous depth shading, distinguishing itself from voxelization by avoiding hard boundaries.
